title: Play-Nice Room Contract Responses
description: Machine shapes for the ROOM contract v0 (contracts/interfaces/ROOM.md). A room is any service that serves the same five HTTP endpoints so a front door can render and act on it without owning its code. Root schema is the union of the five response shapes; named shapes live in $defs. Honesty rules are structural: status is a closed vocabulary where unknown is not healthy, freshness carries observed_at + stale_after_s, and no shape admits a secret value.

room_status.description: Room status vocabulary. healthy/degraded/unknown are shared-vocabulary states; unhealthy is the room observed not-ok (the shared vocabulary's needs_attention/unavailable class). unknown is NOT healthy and NOT failed.

card_tone.description: Optional card display hint. It is never a priority: there is no critical/alert/warning tone (urgency lives in needs-you). Absent or unknown values are treated as 'update' by consumers, logged, and never crash.

same_origin_path.description: Same-origin path that opens the exact item: starts with a single '/', never '//' (protocol-relative) or '/\\' (browser-normalized to '//'), and carries no scheme. Consumers MUST reject any other value rather than following it.

autonomy.description: Autonomy level. Effective autonomy is the strictest of caller policy, room default, and the non-lowerable class floor (deploy, secrets, default-branch pushes, deletes, spending are always ask_first).

observed_at.description: RFC 3339 time the data was observed.

stale_after_s.description: Seconds after observed_at at which the data is stale and must be labelled, never shown as current.

contract.description: Interface version marker. The path stays /room; this field declares the contract value. A consumer that does not understand it fails clearly (Versioning and Compatibility).

voice.description: Optional display persona label the front door may caption the room with. Never a claim about a person.

link.description: Same-origin path the front door may follow.

why.description: Why this needs the owner's attention now.

actions.description: Action ids published by GET /room/actions that resolve this need.

choices.description: Optional. For a need that is a choice: the options a front door may offer as buttons. The picked one is sent as the action's input.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the action's input.

writes.description: True when invoking the action can change state outside the room's response.

action_receipt.title: POST /room/actions/{id}
action_receipt.description: Idempotent receipt for an action invocation, keyed by the Idempotency-Key header (see Idempotency). Returned for success, refusal, and failure alike; never a silent success.

ok.description: False for a refusal or failure; the summary must still be honest.

changed.description: Exactly what changed; empty when nothing did.
